Hi Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and the spike numbers. We can support this and keep things predictable for finance. High-level options (short summary):

Option A — Provisional uplift + tiered overrun (recommended)
- Short-term uplift: reserve + 15% headroom for 72 hours starting at a scheduled window.
- Overrun tiers after uplift: 0-10% over uplift = base rate * 1.6; 10-30% = base rate * 2.4; 30%+ = base rate * 3.0.
- One-time launch credit: 10% credit applied to uplift token usage (to soften early launch costs).
- Billing: monthly true-up; retroactive credits applied on next invoice.

Option B — Temporary blended uplift rate
- Reserve uplift converted to a blended per-token rate for the window (easiest for accounting).
- No tiered surcharges; beyond blended cap billed at base overrun * 2.0.

Operational notes:
- We can auto-enable KV/prefix caching for your launch routes to reduce effective token consumption; our console will show token breakdown per route.
- Any uplift requires a short amendment (1 page) that we can attach to your contract. I27ve attached a draft (BB-Amendment-proposal-v1.pdf) with the graded overrun matrix and suggested dates.

Next steps I suggest: pick A or B and confirm the planned window start. If you want, we can tentatively schedule the uplift for 06:00 UTC on May 3 and hold it for 72 hours; procurement can sign the amendment and issue a PO.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
